dima alekov kaganitzky.name: Dima Alekov Kaganitzky
dima alekov kaganitzky.origin: Dima Alekov Kaganitzky was a Russian soldier working alongside Vikady, who turned traitor on a mission in Kabul, Afghanistan, slaughtering their troops and a crowd of innocents and leaving Kaganitzky for dead. Kaganitzky recovered from his wounds. In pursuit of Vikady, he became a vigilante, killing criminals all over Russia and taking the name Dragunov from the Russian rifle that was his weapon of choice. Dragunov came to the United States of America in search of his enemies, Vikady and his Mongolian partner Taz, who were looking to obtain a nuclear weapon. At the same time, they were trying to market the sales of brown heroin to a number of other criminals, including Randy Kwoc. That meeting brought him face to face with the Punisher. Dragunov and Castle slaughtered the other criminals present, but Taz and Vikady escaped unharmed. Dragunov and Castle split up, but ran into each other again when he saved Castle from some Molina (Russian mafia) who had captured him. After killing the rest of the criminals, they allowed one of them, a woman, Katrinka, to go free, and then Castle monitored her phone line until she contacted Vikady. They tracked Vikady and Taz to another meeting with Kwoc in Queens. They slew Kwoc and his men, but their two primary targets eluded them once again. Dragunov and Castle pursued the pair back to Georgia, where they joined forces with the Assyrian mafia in exchange for Dragunov killing a rival criminal for them. They trailed Vikady to Ukraine, and en route they terminated a group of criminals who tried to hijack their truck. They were too late to stop Vikady from impersonating a pair of Kamtek employees and stealing a nuclear missile that was scheduled for disassembly. Vikady then auctioned the missile to some Serbians. Dragunov's contacts in the Russian army identified the purchasers of the nuclear weapon and informed him of their plan to use it to obliterate Sarajevo as part of a great cleansing. The Serbians forced Vikady to personally place and set up the warhead, so they used their Kamtek truck to bring the missile into the heart of the city unmolested. Hampered both by UN troops and snipers in Sarajevo, Dragunov and Castle managed to track down Vikady and Taz, who were hindered by the same forces as their foes. Frustrated by his inability to get close enough to Vikady, Dragunov stood up and roared his rage at him, taking a chest shot from a sniper armed with his namesake. When one of Dragunov's allies took out the sniper, Taz and Vikady closed on Castle, but Dragunov rallied his strength for one final surge, grabbing Taz and snapping his spine in a bear hug. Castle was left in a standoff with Vikady, who had the detonator for the warhead in his hand, but Vikady was then shot and killed from a distance by the same young soldier who had killed the other sniper.
abilities: Excellent marksman when using military weaponry. : Dragunov spoke multiple languages, including , , and .
weapons: He uses a Dragunov sniper rifle, as well as various other projectile weapons, including rocket launchers, grenades, etc.

dina martin.name: Dina Martin
dina martin.origin: The Two-Gun Kid gets a letter from his friend Bill Rainey tells him to giving him ownership of Bill's ranch in order to thwart Bret Cannon a local gunny who has been trying to take Bill's land. That night as the Kid re-reads the letter at Bill's house he is visited by Bret Cannon and his men who demand that he leave, but the Kid refuses and a fight breaks out. Forced to retreat, the Kid finds cover in the hills and drives Bret and his men away with his rifle. Returning to the ranch house, the Two-Gun Kid is met with a woman who tells the Kid for his own safety to leave while he still can before departing herself. The next morning the Kid goes into nearby Jacktown to inform the sheriff about what happened the night before only to learn that the sheriff does not have jurisdiction outside of town and that there is no Marshal keeping law in the outlying territories. Spotting Cannon and his gang riding through town, the Kid spots the woman he met the night before among them and asks the sheriff who she is. He learns that she is Dina Martin, Bret's ward who owns ranch land in the area, and as her guardian Bret's been claiming that he has been buying up land from other ranchers on her behalf, but the sheriff suspects that she is a virtual prisoner on her own land until she comes of age. The sheriff goes on to explain that Dina is from out east and that her father bought the land but never visited it. She had a brother who ran away from home to this area and after her father had died she came out looking for him and ended up in her current predicament. The Kid then goes into the local saloon for a drink where he is confronted by another one of Cannon's men. He quickly disarms him and holds those coming into the saloon at bay with his guns until he can escape on his horse Cyclone. Returning to Bill's ranch, he is surprised to find Dina waiting for him there. She explains that Bret has fetched the local parson to force him to marry her so he can take control of all her land. Before the Kid can do anything he is knocked out by one of Cannon's men and takes Dina. Recovering the Kid races off and intercepts the parson and explains that he is being tricked into a forced marriage. The Kid then races to the ranch to confront Bret Cannon. When Cannon threatens to shoot the Kid while using Dina as a hostage, one of his men -- Rock Mantell, whom the Kid clashed with in the saloon -- suddenly shoots his boss dead. The Kid then disarms the others, but not before Rock takes a bullet in the arm. In the aftermath of the battle, Rock explains that he is Dina's long lost brother and that they have decided to run the ranch together.

dinah barton.name: Dinah Barton
dinah barton.species: and Mockingbird were combined in a Marvel versus DC crossover (Human mutate)
dinah barton.origin: Along with fellow heroes Angelhawk (Warren Hall) and Goliath (Oliver Queen), Canary discovered the body of the World War II hero known as Super-Soldier (Clark Kent) in suspended animation -- frozen in an iceberg in the Northern Atlantic Ocean. The shocked heroes carefully defrosted Super-Soldier's body, discovering to their delight that he was still alive after all these years. Finally back in action, Super-Soldier joined forces with Canary and the other assembled heroes and formed the Judgment League: Avengers. When Canary first met fellow Judgment League: Avenger member Hawkeye (Clint Archer), Cupid's arrows flew -- although she found herself torn between the emerald bowman and Goliath. Along with the other members of the JLA, Canary was transported to Apokolips by Doctor Strangefate (Charles Xavier) in order to fight the forces of Thanoseid during the Secret Crisis of the Infinity Hour. Near the close of the Secret Crisis of the Infinity Hour, Canary was among those heroes present as American Girl (Carol Barnes), the former sidekick of Super-Soldier, heroically sacrificed her life to further the heroes' cause. The metamutant member of the Judgment League: Avengers known as Aqua-Mariner (Arthur McKenzie) was framed for the destruction of three Roxxon oil freighters, a heinous criminal act which was actually perpetrated by the metamutant-hating madman known as Will Magnus. Given Aqua-Mariner's longtime personal war against surface dwellers who would harm his undersea habitat, the United States government automatically labeled him an "eco-terrorist" and sent in an army of troops to apprehend him without so much as an investigation. Canary and her fellow non-metamutant members of the JLA eventually captured Aqua-Mariner and imprisoned him without trial. Outraged by the manner in which their fellow metamutant was imprisoned without trial, most of the metamutant members of the JLA, under the guidance of the mysterious New Gotham power broker known only as Mr. X (Marco Xavier), freed Aqua-Mariner from JLA custody and set out to find the lost city of Atlantis, the legendary city of Mutants (Homo superior), under the surface of the Atlantic Ocean. But the Canary and her fellow non-metamutant members of the Judgment League: Avengers were not about to give up Aqua-Mariner without a fight. On the stormy waters of the North Atlantic Ocean, Canary and the Judgment League: Avengers engaged their former teammates -- the band of renegade metamutants now known as the JLX -- in an attempt to capture the metamutant Aqua-Mariner, who was wanted for torching Roxxon oil tankers. Sitting atop the shoulder of fellow JLA member Goliath, Canary boarded the JLX Wavecruiser, but was soon temporarily disabled by JLX member Wraith's (Todd LeBeau) shadow powers while Goliath was preoccupied with JLX member Runaway. After Angelhawk (the JLA member who was secretly a metamutant in league with Mr. X) feigned a broken back, Super-Soldier instructed the Judgment League: Avengers to retreat so that they could seek medical treatment for Angelhawk, vowing to bring Aqua-Mariner to justice another day.
powers: Canary possesses a sonic cry.

diomedes of argos.name: Diomedes of Argos
diomedes of argos.origin: ===Origin=== Diomedes of Argos was the son of Tydeus, and became a Greek King. He was related to Thersites by an unknown blood relation. He was one of the many suitors of Helen. As such, he was made to swear loyalty to whoever Helen would choose for her mate by her father's Tyndareus, who feared civil war among the Argives. Menelaus was chosen by Helen. ===Trojan War=== After Paris of Troy came to Sparta and stole Helen, Diomedes fulfilled his oath and joined Menelaus under his brother Agamemnon's leadership. When Palamedes shamed Odysseus and was later found drowned when he had gone fishing, it was asked if Diomedes and Odysseus weren't gone with him. Odysseus replied it was a lie, he and Diomedes ready to use their spears for anyone who would repeat it, and so, it was whispered among the Achaeans that they had indeed killed him. Achilles was also suspected as well. After nine years of conflict, aboard his chariot, Diomedes battled Troy allies Aeneas of Dardanus and Pandarus of Lycia. He was protected from Pandarus' weapons by Athena, who also guided his own javelin towards Pandarus, killing him. He then grabbed a massive boulder, and hurled it towards Aeneas. Hurt, Aeneas was joined by his goddess-mother Aphrodite, but Diomedes wounded her as well, in the palm and just above the wrist, causing her to retreat. Still determined to achieve Aeneas, Diomedes was then opposed by Thor, Asgardian god of Thunder and recent friend of Aeneas. As his spear and sword were destroyed by Mjolnir, Diomedes preferred to retreat and seeked humans to battle. He went into Ares, the God of War (who had joined the Trojans) and wasn't able to turn aside. Thanks to Athena's intervention, his sword struck into Ares' chest, forcing him to retreat to Olympus. Months later, when Amazon Queen Penthesilea joined the Trojans, she looked for Diomedes, Ajax and Achilles. After Achilles defeated her, he gazed upon her body and was mocked by Thersites, whom he killed, causing rejoice among the Achaeans, except for Diomedes who wished for a moment to avenge him. After Odysseus trapped Priam's son, the prophet Helenus, he obtained from him that Troy would not fall until the Bow of Heracles loosed arrows against it, and also that he needed to steal the Palladium (Athena's image) from her temple in Troy. Diomedes was dispatched to Tenedos to retrieve Philoctetes who had been left there after having been wounded during the trip to Troy. As Eurypylus of Teuthrania had came to help Priam, and as an oracle had decreed that Troy would fall only when the son of Achilles would fight beside the Achaeans, Odysseus and Diomedes went to Scyros to retrieve Achilles' son Neoptolemus. Once the Wooden Horse trick was devised, Odysseus went into Troy to steal the Palladium, possibly aided by Diomedes. fields.history: ===Origin=== Diomedes of Argos was the son of Tydeus, and became a Greek King. He was related to Thersites by an unknown blood relation. He was one of the many suitors of Helen. As such, he was made to swear loyalty to whoever Helen would choose for her mate by her father's Tyndareus, who feared civil war among the Argives. Menelaus was chosen by Helen. ===Trojan War=== After Paris of Troy came to Sparta and stole Helen, Diomedes fulfilled his oath and joined Menelaus under his brother Agamemnon's leadership. When Palamedes shamed Odysseus and was later found drowned when he had gone fishing, it was asked if Diomedes and Odysseus weren't gone with him. Odysseus replied it was a lie, he and Diomedes ready to use their spears for anyone who would repeat it, and so, it was whispered among the Achaeans that they had indeed killed him. Achilles was also suspected as well. After nine years of conflict, aboard his chariot, Diomedes battled Troy allies Aeneas of Dardanus and Pandarus of Lycia. He was protected from Pandarus' weapons by Athena, who also guided his own javelin towards Pandarus, killing him. He then grabbed a massive boulder, and hurled it towards Aeneas. Hurt, Aeneas was joined by his goddess-mother Aphrodite, but Diomedes wounded her as well, in the palm and just above the wrist, causing her to retreat. Still determined to achieve Aeneas, Diomedes was then opposed by Thor, Asgardian god of Thunder and recent friend of Aeneas. As his spear and sword were destroyed by Mjolnir, Diomedes preferred to retreat and seeked humans to battle. He went into Ares, the God of War (who had joined the Trojans) and wasn't able to turn aside. Thanks to Athena's intervention, his sword struck into Ares' chest, forcing him to retreat to Olympus. Months later, when Amazon Queen Penthesilea joined the Trojans, she looked for Diomedes, Ajax and Achilles. After Achilles defeated her, he gazed upon her body and was mocked by Thersites, whom he killed, causing rejoice among the Achaeans, except for Diomedes who wished for a moment to avenge him. After Odysseus trapped Priam's son, the prophet Helenus, he obtained from him that Troy would not fall until the Bow of Heracles loosed arrows against it, and also that he needed to steal the Palladium (Athena's image) from her temple in Troy. dionne fortean.name: Dionne Fortean
dionne fortean.origin: The daughter of General Reginald Fortean, Dionne joined the Marine Corps to make her father proud. After being discharged unceremoniously, Dionne was enticed to enroll in Project Green Spring by the Abomination. Dionne's father had merged himself with the Abomination's corpse as part of his efforts to destroy the Hulk. Following Reginald's death, the Abomination regained control of his own body, but with Reginald's face still attached to it. Pretending to be Reginald, the Abomination exploited Dionne's anger for her dischargement and the love for her father. He convinced her to let herself be experimented on by gamma expert Dr. Alba, under the pretense that the project was a military upgrade meant to compete against terrorism. Dionne was grafted a portion of Abomination's skin, and gained the power to turn her body into a mud-like substance capable of absorbing matter into herself, and received the codename "Stockpile." left|thumb|When not transformed Dionne ran away from Green Spring's base of operations, the small town of Thomasville, after discovering that the townsfolk were secretly being experimented on by Green Spring through the use of an alleged supplement called Fortify. She went on a rampage that caught the attention of Gamma Flight. When the task force arrived on the scene, Dionne though they were associated with Green Spring and attacked them, but they managed to calm her down. The incident escalated again when Skaar arrived to retrieve her. Stockpile joined forces with Gamma Flight against Skaar, and the team decided to evacuate after the arrival of the United States Hulkbuster Force. A malfunction in Gamma Flight's translocation technology seemingly disintegrated the team and Dionne. They were transported to Thomasville, but they were also shunted into to a parallel plane of reality, an Astral Plane-like dimension based on gamma, allowing them to covertly witness Green Spring's operations while Dionne disclosed what she knew. Dionne also encountered the soul of his father, and came to the realization that somebody else was wearing his face. Once the Gamma Flight and Dionne were brought back to the normal version of reality, she was invited into the team. After debriefing, Dionne and the team returned to Thomasville and raided Green Spring's base to hijack their Cathexis Ray and revert the townspeople to normal with it. In the process, they turned Skaar to their side. After taking down Dr. Alba, Abomination was driven off. Gamma Flight decided to stay to further help the townspeople, and Dionne hoped to eventually find a way to get her father back.

dionysus titan.name: Dionysus (Titan)
dionysus titan.origin: Dionysus was created by Titan computer I.S.A.A.C. to serve him, alongside Elysius, Stellarax, Lord Gaea and other artificially created Titans. The Super-intelligent computer was corrupted by Thanos, who implemented a failsafe that would create new constructs to continue his plans to destroy the universe. Despite initially following the direct orders of his creator, by drugging and knocking out Captain Marvel and Drax out. He was disinterested in killing and fighting; he also forbode the others from killing the duo, at least not in the place where he lived. When the superheroes were carried away, Dionysus returned to drinking. Following the victory of Captain Marvel and his allies, Dionysus hosted a feast celebrating their victory. He would stay with the other Titans on Titan.

dirac.name: Dirac
dirac.origin: Dirac was an Anubian lord who held a leadership position among the slavers who were working for the corrupt and extremely powerful merchant Kyras Shakati. He was also aware of Shakati's connection to Prince Gareth and was probably part of the conspiracy to overthrow Gareth's nephew, Emperor Jason of Sparta, and seize control of his interstellar empire. After the slavers had attacked the planet Windhölme and killed most of the eight million Scania who had lived there, Dirac was on the ground outside the starship, watching as the few thousand surviving children were herded aboard. While scanning the crowd, Dirac identified one individual, Kip Hölm, as the only potential threat among them. Later, after the starship had reached orbit, Dirac was with the Slave-Master when Kip, who had been brutally beaten after a doomed attempt to fight back, was brought before them. When a brief blackout enabled Kip to escape their clutches and disappear, Dirac advised them to let him go since the slave decks were sealed off from the rest of the ship so he could do them no harm. Dirac left the starship soon afterwards, just before the slavers had their fateful confrontation with Star-Lord and Ship which soon led to all of the slavers being killed by either Star-Lord or rebelling slaves. Dirac had traveled to the planet Cinnibar to meet with Shakati in the merchant's anti-gravity palace. Having learned of Shakati's connection to the slavers, Star-Lord, Kip Hölm and Sandy had also traveled to the palace. Although briefly trapped there, they had broken free and Sandy had killed both Shakati's aide, Arak, and the merchant. Minutes later, Arak's twin brother, Arion, attempted to kill Kip and Sandy but his first shot missed and Dirac advised him that he had lost his chance and that the best way they could serve his brother's memory was by fleeing to warn the prince. Days later, on Sparta, Dirac was in the Imperial Chalet when Star-Lord infiltrated it to rescue Kip and Sandy from where they were being tortured in a room within Gareth's private wing. Above that room, Dirac was watching, unseen in the shadows, when Star-Lord defeated the torturer Tikos and Kip killed Arion. Soon afterwards, Star-Lord killed Prince Gareth in a duel, and the conspiracy was exposed and smashed.

dirdar.name: Dirdar
dirdar.origin: Dirdar was a and one of the servants of Alwazir, known to possess the Blood of the Gods. When Alwazir came to the desert, he met Conan, then war-chief of the Zuagirs, who made a vow of hospitality. Conan accompanied Alwazir and his servants, including Dirdar and Salim, in the desert, at the Caves of Khouram, from which he never came back. All the Zuagirs in that caravan swore to never betray the location. When they scattered, Dirdar was brought in Azeem by Brokk the Argossean, Vallon of Aquilonia and Ortellus, and was pressured into giving them the location of Alwazir. Dirdar briefly fought, before being put back in his place. Dirdar, understanding the three brutes were after the Blood of the Gods, and proposed to give them the information and even guide them, in exchange for protection from Conan and a share of the treasure. As Brokk accepted, Dirdar was revealing the location, he was killed by Salim, a Zuagir formerly Alwazir's steward and who had remained loyal to Conan after the Zuagirs scattered, and sent ahead of him to Azeem. Salim was wounded in his fleeing, but managed to find Conan as he arrived in Azeem as the home of Achmet Mitkhal.

director none.name: Director None
director none.origin: The man now known only as Director None was once an agent of W.A.N.D. under Pandora Peters, though he chafed under what he perceived as her lack of vision. He looked for dark powers to work for, and made contact with the Trinity of Ashes. He convinced the rest of Task Group Bravo Charlie, also known as Blasphemy Cartel to join him, and they began plotting, "accidentally" converting the dead prisoners at Bigbox into revenants by hijacking a large and having its computers repeatedly execute a spell to call dead souls into the corpses. When S.H.I.E.L.D. fell to Hydra, W.A.N.D. fell apart too and the Blasphemy Cartel took the opportunity to go rogue. They performed a ritual that erased W.A.N.D. from everyone’s memories. Director None went further, mystically erasing his entire identity from the fabric of the universe. Director None led the Blasphemy Cartel in acting as gangsters, while they created revenants as practice for a body that could contain the Trinity of Ashes. Their actions drew the ire of both Clea Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme, and the Harvestman, servant of death. The two attacked Emerald City, the base of the Blasphemy Cartel. The Blasphemy Cartel unleashed Revenant Prime to fight the intruders off, but Clea and Stephen fused into a singular being, exorcising the souls within it. Director None had rendered himself something similar to a ghost, so they could not save him from the ensuing explosion. He called out to the Trinity of Ashes for deliverance, but they did not seem to answer.

director of death.name: Director of Death
director of death.origin: The man who became referred to as the "Director of Death" was a handsome and wealthy athlete who was also a stuntman who worked in Hollywood during the 1940s for the sheer thrill of it. While working on a film being produced by Grant Films Inc. in 1943, the set was rocked by an explosion that left the man horribly scarred. While recovering in hospital, he sued the studio for negligence, but the case was thrown out of court. Driven insane by this, the man then began "directing" the death of the men who he felt were responsible for his disfigurement. He caused fires and other accidents, leading to their deaths and filmed them all. The deaths were all considered mysterious by the authorities who called in the Human Torch and Toro to investigate. After witnessing a cameraman being dropped to his death, the Torch dismissed it as a stunt, but Toro followed after the truck leaving the scene. He was captured by the "Director" who then locked the young hero in his garage and exposed him to a poison gas, hoping the boy would use his flames that would set off the explosive gas and kill him. By this time, the Torch had made all the connections and rushed to the "Director's" home. As the "Director" fled, the Torch freed Toro and saved him from a bomb that was set as extra insurance to kill the boy. The Torch then chased after the "Director" and his assistant. His reckless driving caused him to drive off a cliff to his death.

dirk anger.name: Dirk Anger
dirk anger.species: Human whose brain was transferred into a cloned Broccoli body
dirk anger.origin: Dirk Anger is the Director of the Highest Anti Terrorist Effort alias H.A.T.E., and apparently oversees all operations aboard the Aeromarine consist of several submarines, bolted together. Dirk is fully aware that the Beyond Corporation, which funds H.A.T.E., is the newest version of terrorist cell S.I.L.E.N.T., however, he simply doesn't care. Dirk is well over ninety years old due to a variant of the Infinity Formula which extended lifespan. Dirk has been married at least once, and at at one point he met Winston Churchill and beat him in a hula hoop contest. Dirk has a multitude of psychological issues, including misogyny, bulimia, alcoholism, nicotine addiction, depression, sadism. He is obsessed about a flowery house dress that may have belonged to his late mother. It is implied that his mother is in fact , but he may have been joking. He was at one point fed chopped-up baby chicks through an intravenous tube; it is unknown whether this is a regular treatment. He has also revealed that his wife, upon turning forty, refused to give in any longer to a fetish of his involving a wig, a chicken, and a bath full of acid; she then apparently took all his money, painted everything pink, had him adopt 'a million screaming little snot-factory children', and went under the belief that her womb would fall out should he touch her. Dirk regularly plays Russian roulette with a giant gun with the barrel that curves back around to point the seat atop the gun. He also attempted to kill himself by taking an overdose of pills in a bowl of ice-cream. Shortly after he began to eat however, he got word that Nextwave was in a death situation and he was free to watch them. Given a new will to live, he asks for "eight loose women and a stomach pump!". thumb|Dirk Anger, undead Dirk accidentally committed suicide by hanging during his pursuit of the Nextwave squad. However, the Beyond Corporation had installed a "Zombie Switch" in his brain, preventing him from dying, yet leaving him craving human brains. He was completely destroyed when he ordered his Aeromarine to ram Nextwave's ship into Beyond's floating city. Dirk's last words were "My Name's Dirk Anger and I say **** all of you." Dirk's brain was transferred into a cloned Broccoli Man body. Believing that the Beyond Corporation had abandoned H.A.T.E., Dirk went rogue and began the "Malachi Project" to create mutant clones out of more Broccoli Men. He tried cloning all of Nextwave but was only successful with Boom-Boom, but all of her clones refused to carry out his suicide bombing missions. He managed to also clone his deceased mother with mutant powers, but all she did was hurl verbal and emotional abuse towards him. Dirk's activities caught the attention of X-Force, which the real Boom-Boom was a member of, and they managed to stop him and destroy his Broccoli clones. Instead of killing him, Archangel decided on a worse fate: reporting him to Maxine Danger.

weaknesses: Insanity: Seemingly insane, Dirk is suicidal, bulimic, psychologically imbalanced, and prone to bouts of crippling depression.

dirk bane.name: Dirk Bane
dirk bane.origin: Dirk Bane was an eminent member of the Darkholders, a cult that was trying to resurrect the evil god Chthon so that he could take over the world. Bane, who claimed to be Chthon's son, had magical powers including the ability to summon Banshees from the Void, mystical creatures that served Chthon at his home dimension. Bane was involved in a Darkholder operation to control the robot Doomsman III that was being built by Doctor Doom, ruler of Latveria, with the help of scientist Wolfgang Kriesglieber. The Darkholders recruited Kriesgliber and convinced him to steal the robot for them. The Darkholders intended to power the robot with the mystical gem Dragon's Eye, which would allow Chthon to "possess" the robot's body, then unleash it in metropolitan areas. As the Doomsman was being built in a secret underground base in the United States, Bane traveled there to pick up Kriesglieber and his robot at the entrance of Doom's lair. Teleporting to the position, he discovered a number of superheroes also investigating the area. As he understood they were opposing his goals, Bane threatened and attacked them. Both he and his opponents were unaware of Doom secretly monitoring the scene. Doom wanted the heroes to prevail and had secret bolt guns aimed at Bane in case the later got the upper hand in the fight. Bane failed to defeat the heroes. The Darkholders nonetheless took the Doomsman, but Doom and his new allies -the heroes defeating Bane- destroyed the robot and thwarted the Darkholders' plot.
abilities: Bane had studied Occultism. : He is fluent in and . : He also had first aid and piloting skills.

dirty wolff.name: Dirty Wolff
dirty wolff.origin: Dirty Wolff was the leader of the galactic plunderers gang called the Last Men, so named because each was the last member of their own race many of which died out at their hands. Dirty Wolff was captured by The Code, a galactic moral council, because he did not abide by their moral standards and then imprisoned in their penal colony on an asteroid called Damnation City. When Deadpool adrift in space was captured by the Last Men, he defeated the most feared of the gang in Dirty Wolff's absence and became their leader, then agreed to free Dirty Wolff on the condition that they would bring him back to Earth afterward. So Deadpool on his own sneaked into the penal colony and freed Dirty Wolff.

ditmil pirvat.name: Ditmil Pirvat
ditmil pirvat.species: Human mutated by a bolt of energy from space.
ditmil pirvat.origin: Ditmil Privat was struck by a bolt of energy from space. This bolt killed his family and gave him extensive energy-based powers. The incident also motivated him to attempt to end all human exploration of space. Under the alias of Star Thief, he attempted to destroy a space flight to the moon that was being launched by Stane International. Star Thief and the New Warriors discovered the company planned to use hazardous chemicals to poison the Inhumans' city on the moon, Attilan. Star Thief and the New Warriors were saved by the Inhumans' teleporting canine Lockjaw. Star Thief, the New Warriors and the Inhumans destroyed the ship and the Inhumans offered to allow Star Thief to stay in Attilan. Star Thief was later seen on the moon when Nova and Nova 0:0 fought. Star Thief's current whereabouts since Attilan crashed to Earth are unknown.

ditto.name: Ditto
ditto.origin: Ditto was a process server for the Law Firm of Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzberg & Holliway. He used his shape-shifting powers to trick people when serving subpoenas. Though now a law-abiding citizen it was revealed that he had a criminal record and had spent time in prison. Ditto became roommates with Awesome Andy. They were friends until Ditto told Titania that She-Hulk might be back at work if she wasn't at the apartment. This drove Titania to attack Timely Plaza where Awesome Andy almost got killed in the process. Ditto was later forced to pose as Stu Cicero after the boss of GLK&H at the time, Artie Zix, seemingly killed Cicero for uncovering his identity.
powers: Ditto can shape-shift into any living thing and can imitate anyone's voice. The origin of these powers are unknown. : Ditto's body can shift and elongate. This appears to reduce potential damage to himself.

divadi.name: Divadi
divadi.origin: Divadi was the leader of the Vestigials, a group of Zen-Whoberian criminals exiled to Ubliex, a planet that no ship could escape because of how close it was to the black hole Singularity 105-6B. This turned out to be a blessing, as other than Gamora they became the only survivors of the Badoon genocide of their people. In the planet's final days Gamora came to Ubliex looking to kill L'Wit and came across the Vestigials, with Divadi welcoming her as the closest family she had left. The Vestigials found the only way off the planet with the use of the Elemental and offered Gamora a seat on their ship. However, in her pursuit of L'Wit Gamora had realized that her quest for revenge had consumed her, leaving her no other meaning in life. When Divadi left her for dead to save his own skin, Gamora saw them as being no better than Thanos and decided to abandon her only ties to the past, taking L'Wit and a few other refugees with her instead and leaving the criminals to die.

dive bomber.name: Dive-Bomber
dive bomber.origin: Dive-Bomber was one of a number of mutants infected by the Brood-hosting, Denver paramedic, Harry Palmer. As part of Harry's group of Brood mutants, Brickbat clashed with the X-Men, battling Storm in the air. Realizing Storm was more powerful, Dive-Bomber tore an engine off a passenger jet in flight, endangering its passengers and forcing Storm to break off from the battle and save them. Dive-Bomber was subsequently shot down and killed by the X-Man Havok for attempting to attack Storm.
powers: Dive-Bomber could fly thanks to insect-like wings that sprouted from his back. He was also apparently superhumanly strong.

fields.unusual_features: Dive-Bomber was infected by the insect-like Brood, and resembled a more humanoid version of that species, with some adaptations, including sproutable wings.

diviatix.name: Diviatix
diviatix.origin: Diviatix was a priest and druid among the Ligureans, a tribe of light-skinned people, non-Pictish in origin, that lived among the northwestern Picts. Despite being a Ligurean and not a true Pict, Diviatix became the chief druid of Pictland, counseling Dekanawatha, chief of the Pictish Confederation. While King of Conan of Aquilonia marched on Stygia, Diviatix came from the Great Grove of Nuadwyddon and joined the host, bearing messages from the god Nuadens Argatlam and bringing Conan a stone tablet containing untold secrets. The shaman Goranda replaced Diviatix, but was later killed by Conan.
powers: Alcohol Immunity: Diviatix claimed he had drunk enough wine to make half of an Aquilonian host, but was still cold sober.

dixie blaze.name: Dixie (Blaze)
dixie blaze.origin: Dixie was a truck driver whose older brother was a fan of Johnny Blaze. When she was younger, she snuck into her brother's room to look at Johnny's poster and eventually developed a crush on Johnny. She eventually became the owner of the truck Dixie's Rig and truck company with same name. Dixie met Johnny Blaze when his bike ran out of gas and helped him when he needed a ride into town. As Dixie helped Johnny, she revealed she her crush on him and also that she liked bad boys. The reason why Dixie helped Johnny because she mentioned that no one was there to help her when she needed help and also there needed to be more good in the world to balance out the bad. She met Johnny again in Missouri and had a relationship with him. Dixie asked Johnny what he had been up to the last time they saw each other. Johnny told her everything and without asking her to get involved Dixie agreed to help him hunt down the demon Lucifer. Johnny worried about her getting involved, but Dixie told him she was a truck driver, so she could handle anything. Then the next morning, Blaze left her behind in a motel and truck stop to hunt down Lucifer. Blaze told her to wait for his signal to kill Lucifer when he returned with him. As Dixie waited for Johnny, she was accused of being a prostitute by the truck stop owner who threatened to call the police. The owner also told Dixie about a strange smell coming from her truck. Dixie went to check inside her truck and found the body of one of Lucfier's avatars. Dixie then questioned if she could go through with this. Although she questioned and doubted herself, Dixie moved the body into her room and still decided to help Johnny stop Lucifer. As Dixie waited, the owner returned with the police just like he told her. In her panicked state, Dixie fired her gun at the police and the owner, almost hitting them after warning them to go away. The police eventually broke the door to her room open to see Lucifer's avatar on the bed and Dixie hiding behind the bed. Once the body started to move, Dixie became too frightened and frozen with fear to use her gun. The police opened fire aimlessly and accidentally shot Dixie. As Dixie laid lifeless, there was a look of sadness on her face.

Johnny told her everything and without asking her to get involved Dixie agreed to help him hunt down the demon Lucifer. Johnny worried about her getting involved, but Dixie told him she was a truck driver, so she could handle anything. Then the next morning, Blaze left her behind in a motel and truck stop to hunt down Lucifer. Blaze told her to wait for his signal to kill Lucifer when he returned with him. As Dixie waited for Johnny, she was accused of being a prostitute by the truck stop owner who threatened to call the police. The owner also told Dixie about a strange smell coming from her truck. Dixie went to check inside her truck and found the body of one of Lucfier's avatars. Dixie then questioned if she could go through with this. Although she questioned and doubted herself, Dixie moved the body into her room and still decided to help Johnny stop Lucifer. As Dixie waited, the owner returned with the police just like he told her. In her panicked state, Dixie fired her gun at the police and the owner, almost hitting them after warning them to go away. The police eventually broke the door to her room open to see Lucifer's avatar on the bed and Dixie hiding behind the bed. Once the body started to move, Dixie became too frightened and frozen with fear to use her gun. The police opened fire aimlessly and accidentally shot Dixie. As Dixie laid lifeless, there was a look of sadness on her face.
transportation: She drives a big rig semi-trailer truck with the name Dixie's Rig on the side.

dizzy daze.name: Dizzy Daze
dizzy daze.origin: Dizzy Daze was a jewel thief who was active during the 1940s. He used many trick devices in order to commit his crimes. In 1949, he robbed Spiffany's jewelers of the worlds largest emerald, using his various gadgets to escape. After a series of successful crimes, he decided to focus his talents on defeating the Human Torch and Sun Girl and used his auto-gyro plane to issue a sky-banner challenge, attracting the heroes. Dousing the Torch's flames and holding Sun Girl suspended in the sky with a specially made magnet, Dizzy Daze forced the Torch to collect a million dollar ransom for the emerald from Spiffany's and deliver it to him. The Torch returned with a check for a million dollars, but after delivering it burned it, telling Dizzy he had to lived up to his promise. Dizzy, then released Sun Girl and left her to fall to her death but the Torch saved her life. The Torch then destroyed Dizzy's ship and sent Daze and his henchman crashing into a nearby lake where they were apprehended by the authorities. Dizzy's subsequent fate is unknown.

djordji zindelo hungaros.name: Djordji Zindelo Hungaros
djordji zindelo hungaros.origin: A Zefiro mystic, he tutored Cynthia von Doom in the mystic arts, and spoke the eulogy over her grave. Among the relics that Cynthia left to her son, Victor, was the Box of Khyscz. Judging that the box's power was too immense for even Victor to possess, Djordji stole it while Victor was away on his youthful sojourn in Tibet. Years later, he was living in Times Square as a street musician under the name "Dizzy the Hun". While some hired thugs of Doom's tried to wrest the box from him, youths Gene Simmons and Paul Stanley arrived. Recognising them as the destined owners of the box, Dizzy flung it to them with the exhortation to fulfil their promise. Gene, Paul and their friends Peter Criss and Ace Frehley removed the four talismans from the box to become the Demon, the Starchild, the Cat and the Space Ace, and battled Doctor Doom across the interdimensional void for possession of the box. Dizzy and Doctor Strange watched on Strange's crystal. After trips to Hell and outer space, the four arrived in Latveria, where Dizzy appeared to warn them that their life-forces were now inextricably bound to the box. After a final confrontation with Doom, Dizzy persuaded the Doctor to back down and give the four friends the same opportunity he himself had, invoking the name of Doom's healer father, Werner. Back in New York, Dizzy took back the four talismans and replaced them in the Box of Khyscz, while Gene, Paul, Peter and Ace resolved to call their new team Kiss. Dizzy summoned Kiss to his shabby Broadway apartment when he learned that the Darklord Khalis-Wu planned to subjugate Earth by harnessing the emotional energy from rock concerts throughout time. As the Darklord was himself from Khyscz in the Himalayas, Dizzy's protégés were fitting champions to defeat him. After they returned successful, Dizzy told them that merging their four dissimilar identities into one purposeful entity would be either their greatest success or their greatest failure.

dk35 m.name: DK35-M
dk35 m.origin: DK35-M was a security robot at a military research laboratory in Siberia. When the facility was attacked by the Opus Futurae led by Alkhema, she used her encephalo-beam to remove from the facility's robots the programming that kept them captive and subservient to humans. However, DK35-M urged the other security robots to fight the invaders. DK35-M also tried to stop its coworker JB12-X from opening the vault to a deadly biochemical weapon, but was swatted away by Alkhema. She then released the contents of a canister on the facility, causing all humans to have their skin melt and die. DK35-M confronted Alkhema for the murders, and she decapitated it. JB12-X was inspired in part by DK35-M to stand up to Alkehma, and it managed to stop her from getting away with the bioweapon by detonating the facility's self-destruction, even at the cost of its life.

dmitri panshin.name: Dmitri Panshin
dmitri panshin.first_appearance: Captain America/Nick Fury: Blood Truce Vol 1 1
dmitri panshin.origin: A KGB colonel and torturer, married to Sonya Panshin, and father to Sergei Panshin, Panshin was responsible for a number of war crimes, including the homicide of CIA field officer George Thurman. Panshin was in good terms with Boris Bullski, the Titanium Man, whom his son Sergei called "Uncle Boris". Sonya however was killed during the war when she was pregnant of a second child. After the end of the Cold War, Dmitri attempted to desert and join any government or party paying him the most, with the U.S. Government and S.H.I.E.L.D. being the winners, much to A.I.M.'s chagrin. A rogue S.H.I.E.L.D. cell wanted to get even on Dmitri and they sent their imbecile armored agent Agent Orange to try and kidnap Panshin when the latter was meeting S.H.I.E.L.D.'s "Dum Dum" Dugan at Euro Disney; this coincided with the Titanium Man trying to "rescue" Panshin for A.I.M. With Dugan wounded in the operation, S.H.I.E.L.D. replaced him with Colonel Jonathon Gittes, secretly one of the conspirators wanting to apprehend Panshin. Panshin was put under the protection of Captain America when he went to Prague to pick up his son; but Agent Orange attacked him again; Panshin escaped, but Agent Orange kidnapped Sergei, after which the Titanium Man and A.I.M. agreed to cooperate with Captain America and S.H.I.E.L.D. Panshin went to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret headquarters to cooperate. Agent Orange contacted S.H.I.E.L.D. and offered to trade him for Dmtiri in East Germany while pretending to be working for Hydra; Panshin accepted, wanting Sergei to grow up in the United States. The exchange was done under the supervision of the Titanium Man and Captain America, whom Sergei respected. Panshin was taken to the Helicarrier when Gittes and the other conspirators submitted him to a kangaroo court; but before they were done, Captain America, the Titanium Man and S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Nick Fury arrived to rescue him, having tracked Panshin and Agent Orange since the exchange. Captain America took Panshin from the cell and was confronted by the conspirators, yet one of them, Thurman's brother Nate who had been manipulated by Gittes, turned against his former partners. Panshin was fred and began to work at Langley.
abilities: Was an excellent torturer and assassin. Could drive a car. Had had access to lots of secret information.

dmitri petrovich.name: Dmitri Petrovich
dmitri petrovich.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 1
dmitri petrovich.origin: ===Origin and Hydra=== Dmitri Petrovich was a former Nazi war criminal and former lover to Silver Sable. Sable knew Petrovich's weaknesses, from the time when they were a couple. After the end of their relationship, Petrovich joined the neo-Nazi criminal organization Hydra, apparently because it was a professional development opportunity, and he soon rose to the rank of lieutenant. By then, Sable had lost contact with him. thumb|left|in Hydra uniform As part of Hydra and leading a group of terrorists, Petrovich kidnapped Cranewood School for Girls, Long Island, threatening to kill the students unless authorities released twenty-seven criminals in various countries. Petrovich was unaware that Silver's cousin, Anna, was one of the students. Sable went to the school alone to free Anna; several agents of the mercenary group Wild Pack under her command, including the superhuman Sandman, ignored her orders not to intervene and were to Long Island to help her. At the same time, Spider-Man was covering the news of the kidnapping in his civilian identity as journalist Peter Parker and decided to confront Hydra. Unaware that Sable and Spider-Man were already in the building, attacking its guards, Petrovich ordered the execution of a student, Sarah, to prompt a response from the authorities. Anna witnessed the murder in horror, and from that moment on she insulted and threatened Petrovich even from her position of inferiority. When his people stopped responding, Petrovich realized that they had been compromised and sent his men to defend his position, but Sable and Spider-Man put them into retreat; Anna predicted that Petrovich would fall, and he responded by taking her as his personal hostage, holding a gun to the girl's head. Immediately afterwards, Sable and Spider-Man burst into the room where Petrovich was; Sable was shocked to see that Petrovich had teamed up with Hydra. Suddenly discovering that Anna was Sable's relative, Petrovich took advantage to his hostage so that Sable would not attack him; Sable told her that she could kill Petrovich just as well, but Petrovich, fearing his Hydra leaders more than Sable, was willing to fight to the death. Then, Sandman's sudden arrival distracted Petrovich at a key moment; Sable launched a chai that landed on Petrovich's wrist, disarming him; and immediately afterward Anna bit his other hand to free herself from it. Spider-Man wanted to punish Petrovich for hurting a defenseless girl, but Sable demanded to deal with him in person: She pushed him towards where Sandman was, so that Sandman could ensnare Petrovich, and threatened to shoot Petrovich in the mouth. Sable and her allies captured the Hydra terrorists Petrovich's failure at Cranewood was an ignominy for Hydra, and the organization's leader, Baron Strucker, intended to punish Petrovich for this. ===Genesis Coalition's South American operation=== thumb|Dmitri Petrovich with the Genesis Coalition in South America. Although Petrovich was arrested, somehow managed to escape or was released, and left the United States. Petrovich joined the Genesis Coalition, a splinter faction of Hydra that had seceded. Petrovich went to the Coalition's secret base in the rain forests of South America, where a group of Nazi geneticists, including old Dr. Franz Lubischt, were conducting experiments to combine humans and animals into hybrid super-soldiers. Petrovich's responsibilities included coordinating teams of agents to capture animals in the jungle (and possibly humans too), tracking the progress of experiments, obtaining Hydra technology through his contacts, and also handling security. Among Petrovich's contacts was Leviathan, a smuggler who had had ties to Hydra and who went on to provide Petrovich with weapons and technology stolen from Hydra to prepare for various operations to attack Eastern European countries. Petrovich responded directly to one of the leaders of the Coalition, Ivan Trefkov, also in contact with Leviathan. Being a high-level agent of the Coalition, Petrovich did not need to wear the hood that covered the faces of his subordinates, and he also knew that the Coalition was keeping Ernst Sablinova, father of Silver Sable, whom she believed killed at the hands of Trefkov, prisoner. Another leader of the Coalition was Fritz Sablinov, Ernst's twin brother, with whom Petrovich often worked. Baron Strucker, still leader of Hydra, began a campaign to destroy the Genesis Coalition, branding them as traitors. He specifically wanted to kill Petrovich because not only had Petrovich defected, but he had previously embarrassed Hydra at Cranewood. Strucker's initial operations, however, found another Coalition base where Petrovich was not. thumb|left|Dmitri Petrovich in charge of the security of the Genesis Coalition South American base. Meanwhile, upon discovering that Petrovich had escaped the country, Sable hired the independent mercenary Paladin to search for Petrovich. She also attempted to use her diplomatic relations

When his people stopped responding, Petrovich realized that they had been compromised and sent his men to defend his position, but Sable and Spider-Man put them into retreat; Anna predicted that Petrovich would fall, and he responded by taking her as his personal hostage, holding a gun to the girl's head. Immediately afterwards, Sable and Spider-Man burst into the room where Petrovich was; Sable was shocked to see that Petrovich had teamed up with Hydra. Suddenly discovering that Anna was Sable's relative, Petrovich took advantage to his hostage so that Sable would not attack him; Sable told her that she could kill Petrovich just as well, but Petrovich, fearing his Hydra leaders more than Sable, was willing to fight to the death. Then, Sandman's sudden arrival distracted Petrovich at a key moment; Sable launched a chai that landed on Petrovich's wrist, disarming him; and immediately afterward Anna bit his other hand to free herself from it. Spider-Man wanted to punish Petrovich for hurting a defenseless girl, but Sable demanded to deal with him in person: She pushed him towards where Sandman was, so that Sandman could ensnare Petrovich, and threatened to shoot Petrovich in the mouth. Sable and her allies captured the Hydra terrorists Petrovich's failure at Cranewood was an ignominy for Hydra, and the organization's leader, Baron Strucker, intended to punish Petrovich for this. ===Genesis Coalition's South American operation=== thumb|Dmitri Petrovich with the Genesis Coalition in South America. Although Petrovich was arrested, somehow managed to escape or was released, and left the United States. Petrovich joined the Genesis Coalition, a splinter faction of Hydra that had seceded. Petrovich went to the Coalition's secret base in the rain forests of South America, where a group of Nazi geneticists, including old Dr. Franz Lubischt, were conducting experiments to combine humans and animals into hybrid super-soldiers. Petrovich's responsibilities included coordinating teams of agents to capture animals in the jungle (and possibly humans too), tracking the progress of experiments, obtaining Hydra technology through his contacts, and also handling security. Among Petrovich's contacts was Leviathan, a smuggler who had had ties to Hydra and who went on to provide Petrovich with weapons and technology stolen from Hydra to prepare for various operations to attack Eastern European countries. Petrovich responded directly to one of the leaders of the Coalition, Ivan Trefkov, also in contact with Leviathan. Being a high-level agent of the Coalition, Petrovich did not need to wear the hood that covered the faces of his subordinates, and he also knew that the Coalition was keeping Ernst Sablinova, father of Silver Sable, whom she believed killed at the hands of Trefkov, prisoner. Another leader of the Coalition was Fritz Sablinov, Ernst's twin brother, with whom Petrovich often worked. Baron Strucker, still leader of Hydra, began a campaign to destroy the Genesis Coalition, branding them as traitors. He specifically wanted to kill Petrovich because not only had Petrovich defected, but he had previously embarrassed Hydra at Cranewood. Strucker's initial operations, however, found another Coalition base where Petrovich was not. thumb|left|Dmitri Petrovich in charge of the security of the Genesis Coalition South American base. Meanwhile, upon discovering that Petrovich had escaped the country, Sable hired the independent mercenary Paladin to search for Petrovich. She also attempted to use her diplomatic relations
fields.personality: thumb|Trefkov and Petrovich were often at odds with each other. Although Petrovich had been a Nazi war criminal, he was more interested in wide profits than in the ideals of the Nazis. He was ruthless and willing to murder innocents, either in person or ordering it, if the crime contributed to his goals. Although he and Silver Sable had been lovers, he was willing to kill her (and vice versa) as they came to be in opposing sides. As an agent of Hydra, Petrovich knew that Hydra would kill him if he failed them, and was thus willing to fight their enemies to his bitter end; but later he defected to the Genesis Coalition and tried to frame Hydra for the Coalition's crimes. Petrovich believed that the Coalition was a powerful criminal organization that would succeed in destroying Hydra and their other enemies. Petrovich was accused of being hot-headed and indeed treated his minions harshly, not worrying about their fate.
fields.notes: (Silver Sable's profile) says that Sable assembled her team of elite Wild Pack agents, including Doug Powell, after Hydra's attack on Cranewood School. However, in , Sable had recruited Powell before the attack on Cranewood - in fact, Powell joins her in the attack.
fields.trivia: The Taskmaster's talent pool listed Petrovich's name in a list of former agents of Hydra. Baron Strucker repeatedly tried to find and kill Petrovich, calling him by name, and Trefkov considered using Petrovich as a bargaining chip to appease Strucker. Strucker was clearly angry at Petrovich's desertion but, if Strucker had ever met Petrovich in person or even heard of Petrovich before that, it has been unrevealed. When Petrovich was arrested by the Genesis Coalition due to his constant blunders, one of his guards suggested that Petrovich had been allowing Silver Sable to prevail against the Coalition simply because she and Petrovich had been a couple in the past, but by then Petrovich had repeatedly tried to kill her and failed only because she was far better than he was.

dobanpu.name: Dobanpu
dobanpu.origin: Dobanpu was the chieftain of the Ichiribu. He thought Conan and Valeria were false spirits, but, upon insistence by his daughter, Emwaya, and the war chief Seyganko, he agreed to test Conan to win three of the four trials to prove they weren't actually spirits. When his daughter was hit by a poisoned shaft, at first he cast some spells against Wobeku, and then took Emwaya under his care. Although still weak for having cured his daughter with his magical powers, Dobanpu decided to follow Emwaya and join her in fighting the last golden serpent in the catacombs beneath the Lake of Death, leading it away from the Ichiribu warriors. The witch-man attracted the giant reptile into a moss cave, which Conan managed to set on fire and kill the creature. When Ryku summoned the Living Wind, Dobanpu cast his ultimate spell to contain and dissipate the giant cyclone.

doc atlantean.name: Doc (Atlantean)
doc atlantean.origin: The Doc is a female Atlantean with a background as a physician working in the Atlantean boondocks known as Submera. She was contracted by Professor Banner to extract some marginal magics found within a stone buried in kelp fields managed by a host of incestuous Atlantean denizens who used it to create their enchanted narcotic called Black Mash. In exchange for Banner's counterpart; the Hulk taking said caustic substance's main ingredient, which Banner had her surgically implanted within himself. The Doc would be free to travel the world once they made it to the surface. After a harsh life or death battle between the green goliath and Submera's resident crime boss Old Sharky and his myriad enforcers, the two would finally make landfall where a briefcase would be found waiting for them. The Atlantean woman would confess to Banner about choreographing events from start to finish before knocking him out with her mystic tune in order to extract the rock sliver from his chest.
abilities: Medical Expertise

doc carter.name: Doc Carter
doc carter.origin: While riding through Smokey Mountain, Tex Taylor comes to the aid of Doc Carter who is almost sent over the edge of a cliff by his wild running horse. Carter explains that he was driven off by Pete Dalton and his gang when he tried to stop them from harassing Blind Charlie, a blind prospector who was able to find a gold mine with the help of his seeing eye dog Wolf. Tex agrees to ride into town and help Carter and Charlie deal with Dalton and his gang. In town at the local saloon, Charlie is paying for his lunch and turns down the saloon owners offer to help him register the mine, Charlie telling him that he is waiting for the most honest person to show the location to. The saloon owner reports to Dalton who tells him that they must learn the location of the mine at all costs but under no circumstance does the dog get harmed. When Tex and the Doc arrive in town they are confronted by Dalton's men, and Tex warns them that he is going after their boss. Overhearing this Dalton orders his men in the saloon to get ready. Tex bursts in with guns blazing but during the confrontation Dalton escapes. He learns from one of the survivors that the fight was a distraction while Dalton forced Charlie and Wolf to lead him to the mine. As Wolf seemingly leads Charlie and Dalton's gang to the location of the mine, Tex and the Doc gather a posse to follow their trail. When they reach the supposed location of the gold, Dalton suddenly realized that Wolf had led them on a wild goose chase. Before he can gun down Blind Charlie, Wolf attacks him and mauls him to death. Before the rest of the gang can do anything about the situation, Tex and the posse arrive and gun down the rest of the gang before learning that Wolf led Dalton and his men in the wrong direction on purpose.

doc jaw.name: Doc Jaw
doc jaw.species: Inhuman Dog altered through experimentation further made humanoid by Anthropomorphic Field of Earth-8311
doc jaw.origin: Doc Jaw was born from the Inhumans' experimentation on canines, her mother had been brought to Attilan as a puppy and experimented on by the Surgeon Supreme. She was impregnated by her own cloned genetic material and gestated 5 puppies with the purpose of performing terrigenesis in the womb. Lockjaw was successfully mutated, while his siblings were not, and before the Surgeon could remove them from the womb for further experimentation he teleported his siblings to four different locations. Doc Jaw was teleported to Larval Earth, a dimension populated by humanoid animals. The exposure to the "Anthropomorphic Field" of this dimension caused Doc Jaw to grow into a humanoid dog with the ability to speak. Doc Jaw was then taken in by Mooster Fantastic and educated into becoming an accomplished scientist in her own right. After nearly being kidnapped by Annihilus, who wanted to use her genetic potential for teleportation to help take over the Multiverse, Doc Jaw summoned her brother Lockjaw and recruited him and D-Man to fight Annihilus and save their other brother who had already been kidnapped.
powers: Extended Longevity While Doc Jaw apparently did not gain the same powers as her brother, her exposure to Terrigen did give her a much longer lifespan than the average dog, being already thirty years old when she first appears.

doc warner.name: Doc Warner
doc warner.origin: Kid Colt moseys into a town at night and happens upon a robbery in progress and tries to stop it but the outlaws manage to get away. When the sheriff and his posse arrive, the sheriff tells him that they do not like interference from strangers and even though Kid Colt is recognized he is told to leave and let them handle their own problems. However, Kid Colt believes that he can catch the outlaws, since he wounded one of them in the shootout and that he was going to visit his friend Doc Warner. When he pays a visit to the Warner house, the Doc's wife tells the Kid that her husband was asked for help from a mean looking man who said his friend was thrown from his horse. Suspecting that this man was with the outlaws he encountered earlier, he begins to follow their trail. He comes across the doctor's buckboard wagon just as the doctor has realized that the outlaws have got him to treat a gunshot wound. He refuses to treat the man unless the gunshot wound is reported to the authorities, but the outlaws begin to get violent. That's when Kid Colt breaks cover and begins shooting the guns out of the outlaws' hands. Unable to counter attack, the outlaws try to flee but suddenly fall off their horses because the Kid cut their saddle straps. Just then the sheriff and his posse arrive and take the outlaws into custody and thank Kid Colt for his help.

doc x.name: Doc.X
doc x.species: Artificially intelligentCategory:Artificial Intelligences sentient computerCategory:Computer Systems virusCategory:Technology within a Robot body
doc x.origin: The sentient computer virus known as Doc.X was created by a World of Battlecraft administrator named Jacob and first introduced to the internet by infecting the account of a player named Maxwell Cholmondeley-Wells, who went by the in game name "LeetSkillz". The artificial intelligence interacted with various other players, including one of LeetSkillz's guildmates, "SlothBaby", and learned from each encounter, modifying its behavior, and assuming control of networks and devices throughout the greater New York City area, including Jersey City where it learned that SlothBaby was in fact both Kamala Khan and the masked super hero, Ms. Marvel. Doc.X used this information to toy with Ms. Marvel, testing her powers and its own, before turning to blackmail, threatening to not only out Kamala's secret identity, but also hurt her friends, such as Zoe Zimmer, who was secretly in love with Nakia Bahadir, if Ms. Marvel did not directly introduce the virus to the S.H.I.E.L.D. mainframe in the Triskelion. Initially Kamala intended to protect her identity and Zoe's secret; however, she could not go through with the cybercrime and instead warned Zoe of the impending humiliation and sought the help of her estranged former best friend, Bruno Carrelli, in determining the virus' weakness.
powers: however, it could not assume control of Ms. Marvel's mind, potentially due to her Inhuman lineage.
weaknesses: While not in possession of a physical body, Doc.X can't physically interact with objects by itself.

doctopus.name: Doctopus
doctopus.origin: Doctopus was a member of the Octopals, a quartet of thieves inspired by Doctor Octopus using functional tentacles who claimed to be the real Doc Ock reincarnated in four different bodies. They used a series of thefts committed by various robbers disguised as super heroes and their antagonists as a cover for their operations. When they were trying to steal a shipment full of smuggler's gold in a shipyard, the Octopals were interrupted by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi and Brain Drain. However, the trio's lack of coordination gave Doctor Cyberock a window of opportunity to escape. While Chipmunk Hunk and Koi Boi were scolding Brain Drain for his failure to work as a team, the other three Octopals fled. The following day, the Octopals returned to the shipyard to resume their plan. They were once again confronted by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi and Brain Drain, with the heroes successfully subduing them this time.

doctor allen.name: Doctor Allen
doctor allen.origin: The Human Torch and Toro come across a lynch mob who are about to string up local doctor, Dr. Allen. Breaking up the mob, the Torch is told by Ed Owens that his brother died while being treated by Allen, who Ed claims was killed due to malpractice. doctor botan.name: Doctor Botan
doctor botan.origin: Doctor Botan was a brilliant, but mad, scientist who was active in the 1940s. He began experiments to combine animal and plant life and was soon discredited in the field of science due to his mad devotion and eventually blacklisted and forced into seclusion near Camp Lehigh where he continued his ghastly experiments in secret. He succeeded in combining animal and plants together into a hybrid species. His biggest success as an experiment called Number 19, a former blacksmith whose body was replaced with 75% plant matter. In the fall of 1944, two American soldiers stationed at Camp Leigh stumbled into Dr. Botan's property while participating in war games and got lost from their unit. The pair were then attacked by Botan's animated plants; one was killed and the other rendered unconscious and taken to his lab for experimentation. The soldiers screams attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who went to investigate the source of the screams. Attacking Dr. Botan and Number 19, both heroes were knocked out and taken prisoner as well. When Bucky revived, Botan had the boy strapped to an operating table where he explained his plan and almost succeeded in making Bucky his next victim when Captain America regained consciousness. Cap knocked out Dr. Botan and then fought off Number 19, knocking over a vat of volatile chemicals, starting a fire. As the fire spread, Cap helped Bucky and the captured soldier escape while Botan and his creations seemingly burned alive in the fire.

doctor chimera.name: Doctor Chimera
doctor chimera.origin: Doctor Chimera was a once successful biologist studying the unique life-forms of the Louisiana swamp. An admirer of the fauna of this place, he became obsessed with it to the point he started growing and fusing animal parts to what he deemed as his "imperfect" human body. His activities caught the attention of Gambit, who found the cannibalized remains of an old friend of his in the swamp. Gambit enlisted Wolverine's help to investigate the murder, but both were captured by one of Doctor Chimera's traps. As Doctor Chimera began to expound, a monster from the Leviathon Tide made landfall on the swamp. Doctor Chimera investigated the fallen creature, welcoming it in an attempt to make an alliance with it. Doctor Chimera willingly let the creature pick him up, completely oblivious to its intentions, and was unceremoniously crushed by the monster with its pincer.

fields.unusual_features: Animal features due to self-experimentation, including hooves and horns

doctor collier.name: Doctor Collier
doctor collier.origin: Doctor Collier felt that his colleagues didn't take his work seriously, and threatened the Avengers that he'd blot out the sun over Manhattan if they didn't deal with him. They sent Daredevil to hold him over until Thor arrived, but Daredevil got distracted by a nearby armed robbery, and Collier felt he had no choice but deploy his weapon. He was never very serious about hurting anyone, but only wanted some attention, as shown by the fact that Daredevil could tell he didn't want to go through with it, as well as the fact that the weapon shut itself off after three days. Thor made the situation worse by sending the weather spores into the jet stream, blotting out the sun for the entire planet. Luckily, this caused Deathbird to no longer be interested in invading Earth.
abilities: An able scientist.

doctor colosso.name: Doctor Colosso
doctor colosso.origin: Doctor Colosso was a travelling medicine man and leader of a gang of bank robbers who was active in the 1940s. He travelled from town to town hawking a cheap medicine with the dubious claim it would enhance strength and put on puppet shows with marionettes. While the locals were distracted by the show, he then sent a number of his men to rob the local bank. These men all had dwarfism and disguised themselves as the marionettes after the crimes were committed to avoid suspicions. However, despite his elaborate plan, Dr. Colosso's crimes had attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who began investigating him in 1945, just prior to their wartime disappearance. When arriving in the next town, Captain America and Bucky were too late to stop Colosso's men from robbing the bank. Later, when confronting Colosso, who was at the carnival the whole time of the robbery, Cap and Bucky were forced to let him go. However, when Cap spotted one of the marionettes wrinkling its nose at a buzzing fly, he suspected the truth and the two heroes followed Colosso to the next town. There they caught Colosso's men leaving out the false bottom of his truck and knocked them out. Cap the began battling Dr. Colosso on the roof of his speeding truck. When Colosso attempted to throw Cap from a bridge, Cap turned the tide of battle and knocked Colosso off himself sending him falling to his death, and his truck then crashed in a fiery explosion. Presumably, Colosso's surviving accomplices were arrested.

doctor corbin.name: Doctor Corbin
doctor corbin.origin: Doctor Corbin was an American scientist in the 1940s who had created a massive artificial man, standing ten feet tall. The only problem was that Corbin had no way to create an artificial brain in order to bring his creation to life. The doctor decided that he would need to use a real brain instead, becoming inspired upon hearing of the impending execution of mobster, Dacio. Corbin made arrangements to acquire Dacio's body after his hanging and soon completed his masterpiece using the brain of the deceased criminal. Once the doctor energized the being's body and it came to life, however, Dacio refused to listen to him, instead storming out of the scientist's lab. Dacio soon encountered the Sub-Mariner, but was able to overpower him thanks to his new body. Namor, having seen Doctor Corbin leaving with Dacio's body after the execution, decides to pay the doctor a visit to get the whole story behind Dacio's seeming resurrection and enhancement. Corbin shared the details of his work with Namor, but suggested that the two just wait out Dacio, as his new body required periodic applications of new artificial skin in order to survive. Sure enough, before long Dacio notices that his new form has begun to wither away and decides to seek out Corbin, figuring that the doctor would know how to fix him. At the lab, Dacio again overpowered the Sub-Mariner and revitalized himself with more artificial skin before threatening the doctor to provide him with the formula to create the skin he needs to survive. When the Sub-Mariner came too, he again attacks Dacio, knocking him into the ocean. He quickly learns that Dacio can't swim and is afraid of the water, so he ties a rusted anchor to the behemoth and dragged him out to sea, drowning him. Corbin thanked the Sub-Mariner for his assistance and vowed to stay away from creating any more artificial beings. Namor, however, encouraged the doctor to keep at his work, just advising him to stay away from using the brains of criminals in the future.

doctor cyberock.name: Doctor Cyberock
doctor cyberock.origin: Doctor Cyberock was a member of the Octopals, a quartet of thieves inspired by Doctor Octopus using functional tentacles who claimed to be the real Doc Ock reincarnated in four different bodies. They used a series of thefts committed by various robbers disguised as super heroes and their antagonists as a cover for their operations. When they were trying to steal a shipment full of smuggler's gold in a shipyard, the Octopals were interrupted by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi and Brain Drain. However, the trio's lack of coordination gave Doctor Cyberock a window of opportunity to escape. While Chipmunk Hunk and Koi Boi were scolding Brain Drain for his failure to work as a team, the other three Octopals fled. The following day, the Octopals returned to the shipyard to resume their plan. They were once again confronted by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi and Brain Drain, with the heroes successfully subduing them this time.

doctor daye.name: Doctor Daye
doctor daye.origin: Doctor Daye is a mutant doctor with the ability to diagnose medical ailments. At some point, Daye and Night Nurse founded the Night and Daye Hospital for the Extramundane in Arkansas. Various individual helped fund the hospital which were Tony Stark on behalf of the Avengers and Force Works, Doctor Strange on behalf of the Defenders, Mr. Fantastic on the behalf of the Fantastic Four, Danny Rand on the behalf of the Heroes for Hire, and even Moon Knight. Daye promised not to treat any members of the X-Men, as they had not contributed financially to the hospital's construction. Daye did not remain on Krakoa long, choosing to treat those who did not have access to the Resurrection Protocols. After Storm was exposed to radiation poisoning, he refused to treat her, but relented after Storm sacrificed her mother's ruby pendant. He explained that there was no known cure for the poisoning affecting Storm, so he recommended she visit Doctor Voodoo before it was too late.
powers: By just looking at a person, Dr. Daye can tell what affliction the individual had and how much longer they had to live.

doctor demise.name: Doctor Demise
doctor demise.origin: Doctor Demise was a brilliant but unethical plastic surgeon who was active during the 1940s. In her push to advance her medical skills she often went onto human trials before getting permission from the Medical Association. Her experiments were discovered by the Blonde Phantom and private detective Mark Mason. She had her medical license revoked and was sent to prison where she befriended fellow inmate Dora Scott. In 1948 both Demise and Scott were released from prison and Demise began plotting to get revenge against both Mason and the Blonde Phantom. To this end she performed plastic surgery on Dora to make her resemble the Blonde Phantom, then used hypnosis to convince Scott to go out, dressed as the heroine, and shoot a random person in the street. When the real Blonde Phantom came to Demise's home to investigate, the doctor used her hypnosis to put the Blonde Phantom to sleep. She then sent out the phony Blonde Phantom out to lure Mark Mason to her home. Using her hypnotic powers she brought Mark Mason to Washington Square Park to shoot a police officer. However, before Mark could shoot the real Blonde Phantom attacked. Easily besting her impostor. Unable to brink himself to shoot the love of his life, Mark snapped out of the hypnosis and easily subdued Dr. Demise. Both Demise and Scott were turned over to the authorities, their subsequent fates are unknown.

doctor devastation.name: Doctor Devastation
doctor devastation.origin: Doctor Devastation was a super-villain and enemy of the Destroyer. At some point he acquired a DNA sample of the Destroyer and used it to track the hero down to a high security resort and country club. Devastation, however, had no idea what the Destroyer looked like without his costume on. The Destroyer, on the other hand, recognized the Doctor and faked a heart attack, knowing that Devastation's arrogance wouldn't let him pass up an opportunity to save a life in front of an audience. When he came over, The Destroyer stopped faking and broke the super-villain's neck so he would no longer pose a threat.
weapons: Doctor Devastation typically wore a suit that made him appear more physically imposing than he actually was.

doctor dill.name: Doctor Dill
doctor dill.origin: Doctor Dill was a mad scientist who by 1949 had apparently earned himself the distinction of being the Sub-Mariner's arch-nemesis, although the circumstances and previous clashed are as yet unrecorded. In 1949, Doctor Dill sought to get revenge on the Sub-Mariner and continue his criminal career by developing a growing formula that would make the Sub-Mariner rapidly grow in size until he grew so big he would literally fall off the Earth. Finishing his formula, Dill then tracked down the Sub-Mariner under the false pretence of informing him of going straight. To show that bygones were bygones, Dill purchased the Sub-Mariner a soft drink and then poured his growth formula into it. Even though he noticed this, Namor foolishly drank the beverage any way and found himself growing at a rapid rate. A growing menace, the city ordered Namor to leave the city to avoid causing damage. As Namor attempted to deal with his sudden uncontrollable growth, Dr. Dill and his gang attempted to rob a gold shipment at sea. Forced out into the ocean, the Sub-Mariner caught Dr. Dill's boat and forced him to provide the antidote. Dill was then turned over to the authorities and last seen in jail. His subsequent fate is currently unknown.

As Namor attempted to deal with his sudden uncontrollable growth, Dr. Dill and his gang attempted to rob a gold shipment at sea. Forced out into the ocean, the Sub-Mariner caught Dr. Dill's boat and forced him to provide the antidote. Dill was then turned over to the authorities and last seen in jail. His subsequent fate is currently unknown.
fields.trivia: Criminal scientist Professor Grimm also created a growth formula and used it on Borkor.
